name: techdella/logo-strip
title: Logo strip
description: "Trusted by" label + client logos (real, permissioned clients only).

techdella.help: permissionConfirmed: only add a client whose logo use is confirmed in writing (and who is one of the published case studies, §2.4). Items: {name, image (theme key or attachment ID), height (px)}. With no image the name renders as text in the same visual weight.
